# A11

A11 is an evidence-gated agent systems surface for retrieval, decisions, controlled execution, and owner-accountable automation.

Canonical public identity:
- https://a11-k.space/
- https://github.com/angellllkr-eng/a11-rag-platform

Core operating principles:
- Observe real state before acting.
- Protect identity, authority, secrets, and irreversible operations.
- Execute only within explicit policy.
- Verify outcomes with direct evidence.
- Record redacted execution evidence.
- Handoff decisions to an accountable owner when required.

Machine payments:
- Protocols: MPP and x402.
- Payment boundary: HTTP 402 challenge -> payment credential -> verified execution -> receipt/evidence.
- Preferred use: pay-per-call, metered access, and agent-to-service transactions.
- Safety: payment is subject to owner-defined spend limits and route/tool policy.

Important runtime status:
- The public A11 surface documents this capability.
- Cloudflare account-level payment wiring is not claimed live until directly verified.
- Do not infer production payment activation from documentation alone.
